en.title: Maximum Price of a Plan and a Feature Under Incompatibility Constraints
en.description:
Choose one plan and one feature; the given incompatible index pairs cannot be chosen. At least one compatible combination exists; find the maximum total price.

The standard I/O and solution were written independently by this site; ranges marked as this site's are not original source constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n m X; 2≤n,m≤100000, 1≤X≤min(200000,nm−1); then two lines of price arrays (1..10⁹); followed by X lines of incompatible pairs, numbered from 1.
en.explanation: Example 1: 8+4 and 5+7 both give 12; 8+7 is forbidden. Example 2: only plan 2 and feature 2 can be paired, for a total price of 6. Example 3: the highest pair 9+8 is allowed, for a total price of 17.
hints: Sort features by price in descending order, and for each plan scan until the first compatible feature. The total number of failed checks is ≤X; take the maximum of each plan's best total price.
